# ChronoSieve

> A C11 and Python library that turns timestamped numeric telemetry into per-tick intervals, wake decisions and Markdown digests. The caller owns collection, storage and notification delivery.

## Select a tool

- Use Python `ChronoSieve.step(t, y, preds=...)` for a numeric channel. Timestamps must be finite and nondecreasing. Optionally pass one prediction per forecaster and a matching active mask.
- Inspect `should_wake` on each result. `digest_markdown` contains a summary on wakes. `zoom(t0, t1)` returns original records from the retained ring buffer over the inclusive range. Check `truncated` when requesting older samples.
- Use `EDetector.step` or `ingest_batch` for a standalone change detector. Choose the family according to the null assumptions of your stream.
- For MCP, call `chronosieve_create_channel`, then `chronosieve_ingest` with parallel `ts` and `ys` arrays. Query `chronosieve_zoom` or `chronosieve_digest` using the same channel in that server process.
- [Git install, replay and expected output](https://github.com/pgg898200-ship-it/chronosieve#replay-one-latency-spike)
- [Executable notebook](https://github.com/pgg898200-ship-it/chronosieve/blob/main/examples/replay_a_latency_spike.ipynb)

## Documentation & Specifications

- [README.md](README.md): Overview, Apple M4 verified benchmarks, ecosystem comparison, and quickstarts.
- [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt): Complete technical specification, mathematical formulas, full Python/C11/CLI/MCP API reference, and pitfalls.
- [SKILL.md](SKILL.md): Drop-in operational skill instructions for AI coding and SRE agents.
- [include/chronosieve.h](include/chronosieve.h): Portable C11 public header (zero external dependencies).
- [python/chronosieve/_core.pyi](python/chronosieve/_core.pyi): Complete Python type stubs.
- [python/chronosieve/mcp_server.py](python/chronosieve/mcp_server.py): Zero-dependency JSON-RPC 2.0 stdio MCP server.

## Benchmarks & Verification

- [benchmarks/run_all.py](benchmarks/run_all.py): Master reproducible benchmark runner (throughput, Monte Carlo mathematical proofs, token reduction).
- [benchmarks/results_m4.json](benchmarks/results_m4.json): Measured Apple M4 NEON baseline results.
- [tests/](tests/): C11 ASan/UBSan tests (NEON, x86_64 AVX2, Scalar), SIMD vs. scalar parity (`< 1e-12`, NEON `1.14e-15`, AVX2 `7.85e-16`), and 29 pytest mathematical, LLM-eval, & MCP integration tests.

## Optional alarm handling

- [KthWake](https://github.com/pgg898200-ship-it/chronosieve/tree/releases/kthwake-0.1.0/companions/kthwake) counts alarms in event-time windows and emits policy transitions. [Incident replay](https://github.com/pgg898200-ship-it/chronosieve/blob/main/examples/alarm_escalation.py).
- [Guardshift](https://github.com/pgg898200-ship-it/chronosieve/tree/releases/guardshift/guardshift) routes a detector alarm with capacity or queue guards. [Routing example](https://github.com/pgg898200-ship-it/chronosieve/blob/releases/guardshift/guardshift/examples/chronosieve_routing.py).
